app.title: paplot: interactive HTML reports for cancer genome analysis (QC, chromosomal aberrations, mutation matrix)
app.summary: A command turns tab- or comma-separated results from a cohort's genome analysis into a set of linked HTML report pages, opened from an index page. On the QC page the person brushes an overview bar strip to zoom every sample's stacked QC bars to that range, and sorts all the charts by one metric. On the chromosomal aberration page the person brushes a region on a genome-wide breakpoint histogram to highlight or hide the samples with breakpoints there, then opens any sample's circular link diagram in a floating window. On the mutation matrix page the person filters genes by how often they are mutated, toggles mutation types, and sorts samples and genes, including an automatic waterfall ordering, then exports the figure.

task.text: Look over per-sample genome analysis results across a whole cohort, find samples and genes with a pattern, and save presentable figures.

data.text: Per-sample tables from a sequencing pipeline: QC metrics per sample, breakpoint pairs (chromosome, position, optional type and genes) per sample, and gene-level mutation calls with a mutation type per sample.
data.item: a sample in a sequenced cohort, with its QC values, its structural breakpoints and its mutated genes

stage.text: exploring a cohort's pipeline results after variant and structural-variant calling, as a shareable report

mechanism.text: Each report page couples an overview control to the detailed charts: a brushable strip zooms or filters the linked charts, and selecting a sample or gene in one chart highlights it in the marginal bars and the matrix. Sort and filter forms reorder or cut the shared sample and gene axes, and an Export button composes the visible charts into one image.

field.text: cohort-level mutation, structural-variant and sequencing-QC reports in cancer genomics

workflow.name: survey a collection's per-item results across linked overview charts

steps.here: The `paplot qc|ca|mutation` command reads the pipeline's CSV output and a config file, writes data and HTML pages for a project, and links them from an index page.

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: QC metrics are stacked bars, one per sample; each sample's breakpoints are drawn as a small circular chromosome link diagram in a thumbnail grid; mutations are a gene × sample matrix with per-sample count bars above and per-gene rate bars to the left.

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: Brushing the QC overview strip zooms all QC charts to those samples. Brushing a genome region on the breakpoint histogram highlights or hides the samples with breakpoints there. Mutation-matrix genes are cut by % of samples mutated and a maximum count, samples by a maximum mutation number, and clicking the legend toggles mutation types.

steps.step: reorder items to bring out a pattern
steps.here: QC samples are sorted by any metric. Matrix samples are sorted by ID, mutation number or one gene's status, or arranged into an automatic 'Gantt-chart' (waterfall) using the top N genes. Genes are sorted by count or name, and the current sort keys are shown as text.

Clicking a CA thumbnail opens that sample's enlarged link diagram in a draggable floating window. Clicking a matrix cell or bar highlights that sample and gene in all the linked charts, and tooltips give values on hover.
Each page's Export button composes the charts and legends into a single image file through a hidden canvas.

distinctive: The genome is binned along a concatenated chromosome axis, so brushing a stretch of the histogram selects a genomic region and finds every sample with a breakpoint in it
The automatic waterfall sort orders samples by the mutation status of the top N most-mutated genes, the usual oncoprint arrangement
The gene filter uses the share of samples carrying a mutation, and the page reports how many genes were detected in total and how many are left after filtering
The output is a static, self-contained HTML report that is generated once from pipeline files by a command and opened from an index page, not an app that is edited

parts.title: QC graphs
parts.summary: Stacks each sample's QC metrics in bar charts that share one sample axis. A brushable overview strip zooms all the charts, a sort list orders samples by any metric, and clicking a bar highlights that sample everywhere.

parts.title: Chromosomal aberration thumbnails
parts.summary: Draws each sample's breakpoints as a circular chromosome diagram with links between joined positions, in a thumbnail grid. Clicking a thumbnail opens it enlarged in a draggable floating window.

parts.title: Genome region selector
parts.summary: Shows a histogram of breakpoints along the binned genome, coloured by group. Brushing a region highlights, or with the other radio option shows only, the sample thumbnails that have breakpoints in it.

parts.title: Mutation matrix
parts.summary: Shows a gene × sample grid of cells coloured by mutation type, with mutation counts per sample above and per gene to the left. Selections are linked across the three charts, and clicking a legend entry hides or shows that mutation type.
